details: Independent feature-focused suite passed 82/82 across utility observability, utility runtime, and governess rendering.
The snapshot reports exact cumulative jobs, model calls, tool calls, token splits, cost, latest job, route detail, and chronological request/tool/result/failure transcript entries.
A torn final jobs-journal record preserves prior durable history for display while the authoritative routing reader remains fail-closed on corruption.
Transcript rendering excludes raw provider messages, raw tool output, and unrestricted trace bodies.
Whitespace and terminal controls are normalized or stripped before display.
Labeled, bearer, OpenAI/OpenRouter, GitHub, AWS, Google, Slack, GitLab, and similar common credential forms are redacted.
Observability is read-only and does not alter routing, worker execution, or frontier-agent panes.
The lower-agent pane shows queue state, availability, route, delegation counters, cumulative calls/tokens/cost, bounded tools, responses, and blockers.
A 20-column by 5-row lower-agent viewport renders exactly 5 lines with every line at most 20 characters.
A 5-row governess viewport retains both frontier-agent rows and the utility row without overflow.
The governess utility row includes state, model, jobs, calls, tools, tokens, cost, and latest detail.
Project, Objective, Progress, and Next are removed only from board rendering; persisted summary state and its control-path consumers remain intact.
Independent broad utility, governess, bridge, and tmux suite passed 341/341.
bun run build passed and git diff --check passed.
The full suite produced 773 passing tests and four failures already reproduced unchanged in the canonical checkout.
The four baseline failures are confined to stale Codex model/config expectations in paired-options.test.ts and runner.test.ts.

known_limitations: scripts/verify.sh exits successfully but contains placeholder lint, typecheck, unit, and integration commands; explicit Bun suites, build, and diff checks provide the substantive evidence.
Live loop-46 display-pane refresh and pane-ID/PID preservation are release-time checks after integration, not part of this pre-integration evaluator mutation.
notes: PASS. Initial review findings for torn journals, common credential redaction, lower-pane dimensions, and whole-board governess budgeting were fixed and regression-covered before this verdict.
